notes: Short-form copy deck for the scroll-driven homepage. One headline, one line, one telemetry strip per chapter. English is a label, not a second narrative.

chapters.label: SHELF
chapters.line: 任何一本书，都在等第一个读者。
chapters.lineEn: Every book is waiting for its first reader.

chapters.label: CARRY
chapters.line: 纸身进包，云魂跟着回家。

chapters.label: INTERACTION
chapters.line: 书签落下，纸就有了地址。
chapters.lineEn: The ribbon lands. The page has an address.

chapters.label: BINDING
chapters.line: 九页之外，长出一张图谱。
chapters.lineEn: One scan. Nine nodes wake up.

chapters.label: LOOP
chapters.line: 视频、图谱、问答，都在页边。
chapters.lineEn: Video, graph, answers — all in the margin.

chapters.label: READ
chapters.line: 电子档在手里。往下滑，页跟着走。
chapters.lineEn: The e-book in hand. Scroll, and the pages follow.

chapters.label: RETURN
chapters.line: 书不记名。下一位，重新开始。
chapters.lineEn: No reader data. Next reader starts clean.

chapters.label: CHAIN
chapters.line: 书链已经连了 2,600+ 家出版社。
chapters.lineEn: The myth runs on a real network.
